text:
support-ops: FYI prod alert from ACME — p99 on /generate-auth jumped ~5x after canary rollout of runtime v3.9.1. Customer says it started ~13:12 UTC. Can replicate in canary cohort. Logs attached.

andrew: seeing same in telemetry. Coincidentally we bumped kvcache TTL from 10->60s in that canary yesterday. Might be KV miss/eviction pattern + auth refresh fanout.

mia: +1 on auth refresh angle — their calls are auth-heavy (refresh-per-request). Increased TTL could cause stale prefix KVs and larger slow-path work on auth kernel.

jordan: can someone run a quick replay in canary with auth headers? need count+latency distrib. If repro, enable traces for 1% sampling.

sre-bot: alert: p99 /generate-auth (canary cohort) = 1.22s (+520%) | triggered at 6054321950

andrew: mitigation idea: roll canary back to v3.9.0 or flip kvcache TTL back to 10s. Rolling kvcache flip is lower blast radius if config rollback is quick.

katie: repro curl (canary):
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>" -H "x-tenant: acme" "https://canary-infer.redwood.internal/v1/generate-auth" -d '{"prompt":"test"}'
```
Run 100 concurrent to see tail.

mia: repro load script (quick):
```
seq 1 100 | xargs -P 20 -I {} curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer TOKEN" -H "x-tenant: acme" "https://canary-infer.redwood.internal/v1/generate-auth"
```
Also capture `curl -w '%{time_starttransfer}
'` to measure TTFB.

andrew: collecting pprof from canary host now: `pprof --seconds 30 http://canary-host:6060/debug/pprof/profile` — grabbing stacks to see slowpath hotspots.

support-ops: starting config rollback of kvcache TTL on canary to 10s (will take ~30s to propagate). Posting when done.

sre-bot: deploy: config-update/kvcache-ttl -> 10s started by support-ops @6054322010

support-ops: rollback complete, watching metrics.

jordan: initial dashboard shows p99 back to ~230ms. Please keep sampling for 10m and upload traces.

mia: next steps: bisect whether runtime change or config caused it — suggested plan:
- enable kvcache TTL 60s on a small test cohort with telemetry + traces
- flip runtime to v3.9.0 with TTL 60s
- flip runtime to v3.9.1 with TTL 10s
This will isolate config vs runtime.

andrew: agree. I'll schedule the three-step split tomorrow AM and notify SRE. For now, leave canary with TTL=10s.

support-ops: logged customer update: "We've reverted a config change and will run more tests. Will follow up in 2h." :thumbsup:
